base=[3,4,5,6,7,8,9,1,2]
rows=[]
for r in range(23):
    if r==0: row=[first[c%9] for c in range(23)]
    else:
        row=[3]+[base[(c-1)%9] for c in range(1,23)]
        if r<23: row[r]=row[r-1]
    rows.append(row)
print(json.dumps(rows))
